label: Form and medium
text: ST.O.A4.3 — Defence as the stronger form (M17) [clausewitz-c09], [luttwak-c10], [mearsheimer-c03]. Attrition versus annihilation (M16) [freedman-c10], [mao-c10], [luttwak-c09]. Mobile, guerrilla and positional war [mao-c09]. Maritime theory [wylie-c08]; the stopping power of water [mearsheimer-c05] (its grand-strategy use is A1.2). Air theory [wylie-c09], [brodie-c04], [brodie-c05], [brodie-c06], [brodie-c07], [wylie-c12], [luttwak-c13], [luttwak-c19]. Continental theory [wylie-c10]. The "nonstrategy" of naval, air and nuclear theory [luttwak-c12]. Cyber sabotage design poles [buchanan-c06], [buchanan-c07], [future_of_war-c21]. Targeted killing [future_of_war-c22]. Deliberate barbarism as instrument [future_of_war-c19]. Lanchester square law: with aimed fire, homogeneous forces and constant attrition coefficients, fighting strength scales with the square of numbers (uses MA.B.C4 (91A)). Space power and autonomous weapons as means (no cards yet).

warrant.standard: Comparative evidence across theatres; measured outcomes where recorded.
